heroHeadline: Houthis Claim New Wave of Strikes on Saudi Aramco Sites and Airports
heroSubtitle: After a Riyadh airport attack that Saudi authorities say killed 12 on Oct 10, the Houthis claimed seven further missile and drone operations on Oct 24 against Yanbu, Rabigh, the East-West pipeline and airports. Claims remain unconfirmed by Riyadh.
footerNote: Data sourced from official records, major outlets, and institutional analyses. Historical events from established scholarly sources. Contested claims flagged with opposing perspectives.
